title: Airline booking
goal: Show the passenger-facing scope of reserving and ticketing a flight.

rubric.must: Airline Reservation System visibly encloses the flight-search and booking use cases.
Book Flight has dashed «include» arrows pointing toward Select Itinerary, Price Itinerary, Collect Payment, and Issue Ticket.
Collect Payment connects to Payment Processor and Issue Ticket connects to Departure Control as external actors.
Cancel Booking extends Book Flight toward its payment declined extension point.
Frequent Flyer generalizes to Traveller using a hollow triangle.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture omits required include relationships, external actors, and extension and generalization relationships.
